description: Answer key for the planted-error One-Pager (Port Alder ferry authority).

claims.text: Dana Okafor, chief engineer of the Port Alder ferry authority, is the guest.
claims.evidence: Dana Okafor, chief engineer of the Port Alder ferry authority

claims.text: In 2019 the authority's board voted to postpone dredging the channel to save about four million dollars.
claims.evidence: voted to postpone dredging the channel to save about four million dollars

claims.text: A city council vote of 5 to 2 backed the postponement.
At low tide the channel depth fell from eleven meters to 9.1 meters.
claims.evidence: the channel depth fell from eleven meters to 9.1 meters

claims.text: There were 41 groundings in 2023.
Repairs and refunds cost about 6.2 million dollars in 2023.
claims.evidence: Repairs and refunds from those groundings cost about 6.2 million dollars

claims.text: Okafor says the authority ordered two battery-electric ferries in 2022 from a yard in Gdansk at thirty-eight million dollars each.
claims.evidence: two battery-electric ferries from a yard in Gdansk, at thirty-eight million dollars each

claims.text: Diesel fuel costs the authority about 9.2 million dollars a year.
Okafor expects the electric ferries to cut diesel fuel costs by seventy percent.
claims.evidence: we expect the electric ferries to cut that by seventy percent

claims.text: The ferries need a 22 megawatt shore-power upgrade costing twenty-seven million dollars.
claims.evidence: We need a 22 megawatt shore-power upgrade, which costs twenty-seven million dollars

claims.text: Southline Power is paying forty percent of the cost.
Battery capacity drops eighteen percent below minus five Celsius.
claims.evidence: Battery capacity drops eighteen percent below minus five Celsius

claims.text: To compensate, a third charging stop was added at Fenwick Point.
claims.evidence: we added a third charging stop at Fenwick Point

claims.text: The authority carries about 1.8 million riders a year.
claims.evidence: We carry about 1.8 million riders a year

claims.text: Ridership fell seven percent last year.
claims.evidence: Ridership fell seven percent last year

claims.text: Delays caused all of the decline in riders.
The host recommended the deferral of dredging to the board.
Okafor says she would make the 2019 decision again.
Okafor advises testing batteries in the worst season first.
claims.evidence: test batteries in the worst season first

claims.text: Okafor: "I was the one who recommended the deferral, and I regret it."
claims.evidence: I was the one who recommended the deferral, and I regret it

claims.text: Okafor: "Price deferred maintenance honestly."
Okafor: "A ferry that cannot dock is just an expensive lighthouse."
